faqs.q: Is Bridal Royal Zardosi suitable for the muhurtham?
faqs.a: Yes, this is our heaviest bridal design. Dense gold work with pearl and red accents is made to hold its own next to a rich Kanchipuram silk and temple jewellery in wedding photographs.

faqs.q: Which sarees go well with Bridal Royal Zardosi?
faqs.a: Deep maroon, ruby red, rust and traditional gold Kanchipuram silk. Cream or deep green also works when the border has red and gold in it. Send a daylight photo of your saree and we will match the thread shades to it.

faqs.q: How early should I book a bridal design like this?
faqs.a: Book at least 4–6 weeks before the wedding. The embroidery itself takes about 14–21 days; the rest covers courier time, a fitting check and any changes. In peak wedding months, earlier is safer.

faqs.q: Can you change the colours or motifs on Bridal Royal Zardosi?
faqs.a: Yes. Most brides change something: the thread colour to match their saree, a denser or lighter fill, or a different neckline and sleeve finish. Send your saree photo on WhatsApp and we will tell you what works and whether it changes the price.

faqs.q: How do I order Bridal Royal Zardosi?
faqs.a: Tap WhatsApp or Make It Yours and send your saree photo and event date. We confirm the design, price, courier charge and delivery date. You pay a 50% advance, courier your blouse to our Trichy studio, and we send it back by tracked courier once the work is done.
